positions.title: Developer
positions.description:
Worked in team of developers to build features for online platform for volunteers to find events organized by nonprofits
Implemented user-facing components and interactivity based on specific designs

positions.title: Senior Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Taught weekly recitations of 30+ students in CS1332: Data Structures and Algorithms (Java)
Held weekly office hours to assist students with homework, exam prep, technical issues
Wrote and reviewed content for exams and future online course
Evaluated applicants and assisted in interviews for new TAs
Managed and added features to desktop autograder tool used weekly by 20+ TAs (Electron, React)
Managed and added features to data structures visualization tool for use by 600+ students and worldwide (React)

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Paid research assistant for the Adaptive Digital Media (ADAM) Lab in Tech Square
Helped develop and maintain TuneTable, a tangible computational creativity museum installation
Developed logging tool using web technologies (node.js, Electron) in order to aid in iterative design process

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Built and A/B tested saved search functionality in Marketplace for Web (React, Relay) and Facebook Lite (Hack/PHP)
Independently investigated potential UX issues with the Marketplace saved search experience (SQL)

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Created WebRTC stats logging/debugging tool in JS for Messenger Web audio and video calls, integrating with internal call data visualization tool
Deployed logger internally for entire Messenger RTC org
Migrated UI components in React for poor network quality indication in Messenger Web audio and video calls
Redesigned network quality monitor algorithm in JS

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Worked in team of interns to implement and visualize a highly robust three-dimensional container loading algorithm
Used Spring Boot, Node, Express, Redux+React in a full-stack context
Deployed application using TeamCity and Pivotal CloudFoundry
Shadowed full-time developers and learned intricacies of supply chain and truckload rounding

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Designed and built web-based educational tools, including a three.js and AngularJS-based visualization of the n-body problem, and a Vensim model to webpage converter
Taught elementary school and middle school workshops on advanced programming concepts

positions.title: Computer Science Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Organized and led weekly group tutorials to help developing and introductory CS students
Helped design computer science curriculum for web development and C

positions.description:

Implemented an improved k-means clustering algorithm using Apache Spark
